items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met Monk on the street... I said, 'Gee, I’m at the Hickory House... I’d love it if you’d come by some night.' Anyway, he came one night.

ctx.x: One of the most swinging of bassists. Yeah, Wilbur. I used to call him Wilbur B. Ware. [laughs]
Yeah, right. And then Monk came in.
Did Thelonious sit in and play ever?
